summary: The bundled llm-inference-bench v0.7.9 measures the TTFT of a long prompt that arrives while other requests decode
compatibility: No change to serving. lil-bench's standard run is unchanged; the new phase runs only with --mixed-prefill-contexts.
details: llm_decode_bench.py --mixed-only --mixed-prefill-contexts 32k,128k measures, per context, the TTFT of a prompt on an idle server and of the same-size prompt arriving into --mixed-decode-streams (8) decoding streams, and the streams' decode tok/s before, during and after that prefill.
Contexts that exceed the model length, the KV budget or the server's running-request limit are skipped with the reason.
